data.title: Data we collect
data.p1: Compoz Studio only collects data required to operate the admin interface (e.g. content you enter, site settings, and technical logs related to errors).
data.note: No data is sold or shared for advertising purposes.

purposes.title: Purposes
items: Provide and secure access to the admin interface.
Save your content and settings for preview and publishing.
Diagnose errors and improve service stability.

intro.title: What is a cookie?

usage.title: Use of cookies
usage.p1: At this time, Compoz Studio does not use any cookies for advertising, marketing tracking, or audience analytics purposes.
usage.p2: No third-party cookies (Google Analytics, social media pixels, advertising tools, etc.) are installed during your navigation.

technical.title: Strictly necessary cookies
technical.p1: Only strictly necessary cookies required for the technical operation of the application may be used (e.g. session management, security, interface preferences).
technical.p2: These cookies do not require user consent under applicable regulations.
